title: 7.1 Adding and Subtracting Polynomials

icans: I can find the degree of a monomial.
I can write a polynomial in standard form and classify it by its degree and number of terms.
I can add and subtract polynomials, including ones with two variables.

vocab: a number, a variable, or a product of a number and variables with _______________ exponents
the sum of the ____________ of its variables
a monomial or a sum of ____________
the coefficient of the first term in ___________ form

blocks.sec: Part 1 · Notes and examples (fill in each note, then work the example)

notes: Monomial: a number, a variable, or a _______________ of a number and variables with _______________ exponents.
Degree of a monomial: the _______________ of the exponents of its variables.

blocks.stem:
Find the degree of each monomial.
a.  ½x³        b.  −3xy⁴        c.  8        d.  4x²yz³

notes: Polynomial: a monomial or a _______________ of monomials. Binomial: ____ terms. Trinomial: ____ terms.
Degree of a polynomial: the _______________ degree of its terms.
Standard form: exponents _______________ from left to right. Leading coefficient: the coefficient of the _______________ term.

blocks.stem:
Write the polynomial in standard form. Identify the degree and leading coefficient. Then classify it by the number of terms.
15x − x³ + 3

notes: Subtracting polynomials: To subtract a polynomial, add its _______________: change _______________ sign.

tickets.stem: Write 7 − 2x⁴ + x in standard form. Give the degree, the leading coefficient, and the number of terms.
